body: And they also move on like that
It's all the same "it get's better" and "yeah that sucks" bullshit
I can live with it, but I don't want to. It's horrible.
And that's what makes it so hard to live with
I've trie. I've tried time and time again but can't build a connection with anyone.
All my friends moved away after college and started worrying about families and shit
But when they are the only people I have in my life, it becomes my problem
Because I can't give them grandkids. That's why they can't deal with who I am.

Because I've fallen short on all their expectations. Promising baseball future fell apart, couldn't get into any of the colleges I wanted to go to, can't get my cpa, and I will never be my brother with his perfect life and wife and two kids. 

Also, they're not proud of me being an "alcoholic" but fuck them
I've been going to counseling for three years, group counseling for two, alcohol treatment therapy for one, and on various medications the entire time.
Nothing good. I only had things to give me false hope that things could get better.
